editorial:
Imagine being a talented writer who lost everything and now spends his days taking random, boring jobs just to pay the bills. That is exactly where you find John Hayson. He is desperate to fix the mistakes of his past and get his life moving in the right direction again. The vibe is heavy and tense, making you feel like something is about to go wrong at any second. You will feel for John as he tries to do the right thing, but the movie quickly turns into a wild ride. It starts as a slow drama and suddenly crashes into a messy world of lies, romance, and scary crimes that he cannot escape.

What really works here is how the plot keeps you guessing with a few sharp turns. The acting feels real, and the tension builds up in a way that makes you want to see how it ends. Some parts might feel a bit slow, but the payoff is worth it for anyone who likes a good mystery.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when John discovers that the people he trusted were actually using him to cover up an old crime. In the final scenes, a huge fight breaks out that leads to a shocking death. John realizes that trying to fix the past only made things worse. He ends up barely escaping the mess, but he is left broken and alone, proving that some secrets are better off staying buried forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about secrets and bad decisions.
